questions.text: An older student dares you to climb the tallest tower at midnight. What do you do?

answers.GRYFFINDOR: Take the dare and start climbing at once.
answers.RAVENCLAW: Work out the safest route before I move.
answers.HUFFLEPUFF: Refuse, and invite him to share my supper instead.
answers.SLYTHERIN: Dare him back, and make sure everyone sees.

questions.text: The hardest exam of the year is tomorrow, and you are not ready. How do you spend the night?

answers.GRYFFINDOR: Face the hardest part first, and trust my nerve.
answers.RAVENCLAW: Read until I understand every last detail.
answers.HUFFLEPUFF: Study patiently, and help a friend who is struggling.
answers.SLYTHERIN: Work out what matters most, and master that.

questions.text: Your closest friend is cornered by bullies, and you are outnumbered. What now?

answers.GRYFFINDOR: Charge in and fight beside my friend.
answers.RAVENCLAW: Think of a clever distraction to scatter them.
answers.HUFFLEPUFF: Fetch our friends, so nobody stands alone.
answers.SLYTHERIN: Outwit them, and leave them too embarrassed to try again.

questions.text: You find an old locked door deep in the castle, with a ring of keys beside it. What now?

answers.GRYFFINDOR: Ignore the keys and throw my shoulder against the door.
answers.RAVENCLAW: Study the lock and the carvings to pick the right key.
answers.HUFFLEPUFF: Keep trying every key, patiently, until one fits.
answers.SLYTHERIN: Find who owns the door, and win their trust.

questions.text: A wounded creature lies in the forest, and it looks dangerous. What do you do?

answers.GRYFFINDOR: Step up to it, and do not flinch.
answers.RAVENCLAW: Observe it first, to learn what kind it is.
answers.HUFFLEPUFF: Tend its wounds gently, however long it takes.
answers.SLYTHERIN: Earn its trust, and gain a powerful ally.

questions.text: You find a chest of gold in the dark, and it clearly belongs to someone. What do you do?

answers.GRYFFINDOR: Carry it back to its owner myself, whatever the danger.
answers.RAVENCLAW: Examine it first, for a riddle on the lid.
answers.HUFFLEPUFF: Search for its owner, however long it takes.
answers.SLYTHERIN: Return it, and win the owner's lasting gratitude.

questions.text: It is your first night, and the moving staircases have left you lost. What do you do?

answers.GRYFFINDOR: Pick a staircase and leap onto it.
answers.RAVENCLAW: Watch the pattern, and predict where they will turn.
answers.HUFFLEPUFF: Wait for another lost first-year, and find the way together.
answers.SLYTHERIN: Flatter a portrait into showing me the way.

questions.text: A rule seems foolish, and breaking it would help someone. What do you do?

answers.GRYFFINDOR: Break it boldly, and take whatever follows.
answers.RAVENCLAW: Argue the rule is wrong, and prove it.
answers.HUFFLEPUFF: Keep it, and look for a kinder way to help.
answers.SLYTHERIN: Find a loophole the rule never forbade, and use it.

questions.text: You are given a dull, tiring task that no one will thank you for. How do you do it?

answers.GRYFFINDOR: Bravely, as if the whole school were watching.
answers.RAVENCLAW: By inventing a cleverer way to do it.
answers.HUFFLEPUFF: Steadily and well, because it needs doing.
answers.SLYTHERIN: So well that someone important notices.

questions.text: A rainy afternoon, and no lessons. How would you choose to spend it?

answers.GRYFFINDOR: Race across the grounds, rain and all.
answers.RAVENCLAW: Curl up with a book I have never opened.
answers.HUFFLEPUFF: Gather friends for a feast by the fire.
answers.SLYTHERIN: Plan my climb to the top of my year.
